title: Steady handoff 1:1 snapshot — prep for Maya Fernandez
content:
Purpose: short, tactical 1:1 to align on the upcoming handoff (qa -> infra), unblock immediate tasks, and set next week’s micro-commitments. Quick tone: pragmatic, supportive, lots of questions to surface risk.

Top-level agenda (25m):
- 3m  quick personal check-in (energy + capacity)
- 5m  handoff status: what’s done, what’s fragile, what needs pairing
- 7m  blockers & decisions I need from you (escalation/permissions/approvals)
- 6m  career + coaching micro-goal (delegation + incident lead practice)
- 4m  action items & dates, confirm next sync cadence

Notes to self (things to surface early):
- Start by asking: "How are you feeling about the handoff—confidence 1–5?" Helps calibrate psychological safety.
- We need explicit sign-off criteria for the infra team to accept the feature (latency, e2e tests, runbook). Do we have a checklist? If not, assign owner now.
- Memory: last time we missed a fallback path; call out the concrete incident and what prevented rollback.

Current handoff snapshot:
- Feature: dynamic routing config + KV cache seed.
- Status: QA sign-off (smoke tests pass). Load test revealed 7% tail p99 latency bump under burst.
- Fragile bits: rollout script needs a dry-run mode; metric tags inconsistent across services.
- Owners: feature owner = Kavita; infra review = Leila; rollout automation = Arjun.

Blockers & ask list (explicit asks to bring to the 1:1):
- Permission: need access to staging autoscaler config (who grants?) -> Ask Leila to confirm granting path or escalate to infra-privs.
- Decision: keep current circuit-breaker at 150ms or lower to prevent degradation for smaller models. Pro/con trade-off: user-facing latency vs enhanced retries. Need a decision by Wed EOD.
- Resource: require one 2-hour pairing session with infra to run the dry-run and validate scripts. Can you allocate Arjun or approve hire contractor hours?

Metrics & signals to review quickly:
- p50/p95/p99 latency from last load test: 18ms / 42ms / 123ms (peak spike at t=420s).
- Error budget consumption last 7d: 0.8% (target <1%).
- Cost delta estimate for rollout with KV-seed cache warm-up: +6% per 24h during rollout.

Career & coaching micro-goal (7m):
- Coaching theme: delegation + incident leadership. Ask: "Which piece of the rollout do you want to own end-to-end vs hand off?"
- Micro-commit: run one on-call shadow, then be primary for one low-risk rollback event in next 2 weeks.
- Coaching prompts: "What would you try to communicate differently to infra if you had 10 extra minutes?" and "Where could you reduce scope to make the rollout safer?"

Risk heatmap (callouts to mention):
- High: rollout automation lacking dry-run -> potential production config drift.
- Medium: metric tag mismatch -> observability blind spots during fallback.
- Low: small regression in p99 that’s transient but could recur under longer bursts.

Proposed acceptance criteria for handoff: (read-aloud to align)
- All smoke + e2e tests pass in staging;
- Rollout script supports dry-run and auto-rollback threshold configured;
- Runbook written and reviewed (owner assigned);
- Pager rotation updated and on-call notified;
- Post-rollout metrics dashboard created with at least 3 alert thresholds.

Action items (write into Jira during/after meeting) — format: (owner) task — due
- (Kavita) Add dry-run flag to rollout script + small README — due 2028-05-12
- (Arjun) Schedule 2h pairing session and run dry-run on staging — due 2028-05-11
- (Leila) Grant staging-autoscaler adjust perms to "eng-deploy" role or advise escalation path — due 2028-05-10
- (Maya) Draft runbook outline and link w/ runbook template — due 2028-05-11
- (Me / Maya) Confirm rollback metric thresholds and add to dashboard — due 2028-05-13
- (Me) Create brief postmortem template for rollout and assign to Kavita to fill if incident occurs — due 2028-05-14

Notes for follow-up:
- If decision on circuit-breaker not made by Wed EOD, default to conservative value (lower limit) and schedule rollback plan.
- Ensure we have a dedicated Slack channel for the rollout with pinned runbook & PR links.
- Small favors: ask SRE to monitor the first 2 hours after the canary with proactive paging for latency regression.

Conversation prompts & language to use:
- "Walk me through the simplest path that would let us abort the rollout quickly."
- "If you had to remove one piece of telemetry today, what would it be and why?"
- "What would make you sleep better the night of the rollout?" (concrete prompting).

Meeting logistics:
- Duration: 25 minutes; keep tight; if escalation needed, book follow-up 30m with Leila and Arjun.
- Prework: ask Kavita to paste latest load-test summary and link to PR in thread.
- Bring into meeting: staging run logs, last 24h cost estimate, runbook draft link.

Post-meeting flow (my checklist):
- Immediately create the Jira tasks with due dates and tag "handoff".
- Ping SRE channel and confirm monitoring schedule.
- Drop runbook link in rollout channel and request ack from infra.
- Short async note to execs if we decide conservative config to manage expectations (one-paragraph).

Personal reminders (scratch):
- Be explicit about trade-offs; avoid vague "we think" language.
- Pause before committing to deadlines; check calendar for real availability.
- Give Kavita the opportunity to propose mitigations before prescribing them.

Unresolved questions to capture in doc:
- Who is the final approver for infra changes (title/id)?
- Is there an approved contractor budget for 2h pairing sessions this quarter?
- Do we have a test harness for the KV-seed that mirrors production behavior?

End-of-note quick wins to push in meeting if time:
- Add metric tags to the key services (5m job).
- Add a short rollback checklist in the PR description (1–3 bullets).
- Schedule a 30m post-canary check-in for +1 day after rollout.

-- Maya (prep) — will convert to Jira tasks and update this doc after the 1:1.
